tagline: Collaborative document editing: People you share a Genie One document with can now edit it if they have CAN EDIT permission.
what_it_does: Collaborative document editing: People you share a Genie One document with can now edit it if they have CAN EDIT permission. Group memberships in user info: When Genie One retrieves a user's information, it now also returns the user's group memberships. You can use workspace instructions and table descriptions to tailor how Genie One responds to members of specific groups.
why_it_matters: Reuse context from past investigations: When you ask a question similar to one you asked before, Genie One can now use the context from the earlier investigation to answer faster.
